query:
SELECT 'filtered' as type, COUNT(*) as pv, COUNT(DISTINCT ip) as uv 
FROM visitor_logs 
WHERE path NOT LIKE '/src/%'
AND path NOT LIKE '/@%'
AND path NOT LIKE '%.tsx'
AND path NOT LIKE '%.ts'
AND path NOT LIKE '%.css'
AND path NOT LIKE '%.js'
AND path NOT LIKE '%.map'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'unfiltered' as type, COUNT(*) as pv, COUNT(DISTINCT ip) as uv
FROM visitor_logs
